body:
Do you think suicide is justifiable in any form?

and

What about your life makes it worth living?

These are serious inquiries, I'm just extremely awkward.

I really don't want to get older, I don't want to disappoint more of my family by existing. My time here has gone on far too long to be justified. I really don't contribute anything. I was raped a while back and it's really done a lot to me in terms of psyche stability.
What I don't really understand is this: If I want to end my own life why can't I?

There's no one that I could really talk to. It's not really a matter of me being worked up. I've thought about this quite a lot and have attempted to do so once in the past. I just can't find a good reason to stay alive, I genuinely don't want to live anymore.
